3-Ball BB.basis: Value per game = the league's 8 categories as z-scores against the top 170 players (10 teams' rosters); per-game stats from this season once a player has 5 games, ESPN's projection before that. This week = (value − a waiver-level player's) × games left, 0 while out. Injury tags are ESPN's; today's status line comes from the NBA injury report and Sleeper (the official report wins when it's newer).
